title: Nyang Geupeuteubiet le Ujian Ie
intro: Lam kitab-kitab suci jameun, na sidroe tokoh nyang that meusyeuhu nyang kisah jih jimula kon ngon saboh mukjizat nyang dramatis atawa saboh wahyu nyang meu-ulang-ulang, teuma ngon saboh ujian iman nyang sederhana teuma mendalam. Saboh bansa teudong bak simpang jalan, geumita bimbingan ilahi keu pimpinan. Peue nyang teujadi na kheueh saboh ujian nyang that-that carông sampoe jipeugah ureuëng-ureuëng meuiman nyang beutôi-beutôi lamkawan awaknyan. Jeut neubuka misteri nyoe dari petunjuk nyang ka neutinggai?
clues: Lon teuka nibak saboh gareh keturunan nyang dikagumi le rakyat, dan Allah geupiléh lon keu tujuan suci nyang hana hase awaknyan muphom.
Tuboh ulôn jiba tanda peubidaan nyang kureueng bak ureuëng laén, sampoe ulôn teudong meubida lamkawan umat ulôn.
Watèë kruëng njan djipeugah sibagoë ujian, leubèh le djimeu-ulang-ulang—teuma ulôn lôn teukan keu ukeuë, djidjak lé iman njang hana meu-ulang-ulang ateuëh janji Allah.
Lon geuyue bek sagai-sagai lon jep ie nyang teularang, teuma saboh titek pih jiteubiet nibak bibi lon—desya nyang ji-angkée até lon keu siumu masa.
Allah geutakdirkan ulôn meurumpok deungon sidroë gembala muda njang bak saboh uroë akan djeuët keu legendaris sabab djipoh maté sidroë musoh njang that meukuasa.
Watèë teuntra-teuntra njan meu-ulang-ulang, ulôn rhet kon deungon jaroë musoh, tapi deungon keuputosan ilahi sibagoë hukôman ateuëh hana taát ulôn di kruëng.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
